summary.en: BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual entry in Robots

description.en:
BenchCouncil lists Learning robust perceptive locomotion in the Robots area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Learning robust perceptive locomotion for quadrupedal robots in the wild”. The page names Takahiro Miki as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
